name: Doinaka Channel 5 ~Kochira Suzune Gakuen Housou-bu~
original_name: ド田舎ちゃんねる5～こちら鈴音学園放送部～
source:
Doinaka Channel 5 takes place in the countryside. Keisuke and the Suzunone Gakuen broadcast club are asked to help make a TV program to promote the town. However, each segment will be capped at 5 minutes.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/01/01/january-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
